_doc: The one shared file for movement and feel numbers (owner 2026-11-08). One section per system; each value says its unit in its key or note. Read through Tuning.of(section).

vex_air_dash._note: Vex's air dash look (GunslingerKit): the lime fire ribbon her body draws through the barrel roll, and the burst of sparks it leaves from. Distance and timing stay her dash data's.
